title: Check: mock exam 2 review
description: Five questions on the harder half of the curriculum.

questions.prompt: Write the etcdctl subcommand that restores a snapshot from /tmp/etcd.db.
questions.explanation: Then repoint the etcd static Pod's data directory - the restore alone changes nothing running.

questions.prompt: Write the command that creates a Role named reader granting get and list on pods in namespace dev.
questions.explanation: Bind it with `kubectl create rolebinding` - the imperative pair is much faster than writing both YAMLs.

questions.prompt: Which order is right for a cluster upgrade task?

options.text: Drain, upgrade kubeadm, upgrade kubelet, uncordon
Upgrade kubelet, drain, upgrade kubeadm, uncordon

questions.explanation: Drain first so nothing is disrupted mid-upgrade, and uncordon last so the node returns to service deliberately.

questions.prompt: A task asks you to allow only Pods labelled app=web to reach a database. What must the policy include?

options.text: An egress rule on the web Pods only
An ingress rule on the database Pods selecting app=web, with the database as podSelector

questions.explanation: The policy attaches to the Pods being protected; the peer selector names who may reach them.

questions.prompt: Two tasks remain and ten minutes. One is worth 4%, one 12%. What do you do?

options.text: The 4% one, because it is easier

questions.explanation: Marks per minute is the only metric that matters at the end.
